issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Information Technology Laboratory (ITL) AI Program

evidence.quote: provides scientific and technical expertise and contributions to national and international discussions on AI governance. The Program plays a key role as a neutral convener
helps to shape the development of effective and reliable AI and ground AI governance in technical realities

enforcement_authorities: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
National Science and Technology Council Machine Learning and AI Subcommittee
implementation_notes: This page describes NIST ITL AI Program's role as a neutral convener and technical contributor to AI governance discussions at national and international levels, including OECD and G7 Hiroshima Process. No binding requirements or prohibitions are stated. The document is informational and describes coordination roles rather than regulatory mandates.
